Technical documentation

Technical documentation for the Fish import inspection frontend, split by part of the service. The implementation is the source of truth. For setup basics see the repository README.

Document Covers
Server startup and plugins Entry point, createServer(), plugin order, error handler
Routes Route table, route module layout, static assets
Configuration All config keys, environment variables, and defaults
Sessions and caching Yar session, Catbox engines, Redis client
Cookie consent Consent cookie, banner, /cookies routes, client-side behaviour
Security Security headers, CSP, CSRF, cookie and redirect safety
Views and templates Nunjucks setup, shared context, layout, globals and filters
Client assets Vite build, runtime asset serving, JavaScript and SCSS
Logging and observability Logger, request logging and tracing, health check, Pulse
Local development npm scripts, Docker Compose stack, tests, linting
Deployment Dockerfile stages, production runtime, CI workflows
